summary: Consolidated recommendations from the March 2025 PPLAAF/NACAC conference on strengthening whistleblower protection in South Africa.

key_recommendations.title: Independent Whistleblowing Authority
key_recommendations.description: Establish a centralized, independent body to coordinate protection, investigate retaliation, and manage support funds.

key_recommendations.title: Legislative Overhaul
key_recommendations.description: Amend or replace the Protected Disclosures Act (PDA) with a comprehensive Whistleblower Protections Bill.
provisions: Reverse burden of proof in retaliation cases

key_recommendations.title: Rewards and Recognition
key_recommendations.description: Introduce financial rewards based on a percentage of recovered assets and public recognition to shift cultural stigma.

key_recommendations.title: Broadened Scope of Retaliation
key_recommendations.description: Expand 'occupational detriment' to 'detrimental action' covering social ostracism, blacklisting, and online harassment.

stakeholders: PPLAAF (Platform to Protect Whistleblowers in Africa)
Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ)

cultural_pathology.description: Historical stigma associated with reporting wrongdoing, needing cultural transformation to 'Ubuntu hero' status.
